<a id="lagos_fugue"></a>
## The Little Fugue as Afrobeat: `lagos_fugue.yml`

Lagos fugue: the subject of the Little Fugue as seventies Afrobeat. The subject of the Fugue in G
minor, BWV 578 (Johann Sebastian Bach, about 1707) is public domain and is played as written, from
Claude's knowledge of the score, in its key and then a fourth lower, as a fugue's second voice
answers; the bass figure, the guitar's line, the horn stabs, the solos and the drums are new.
